coverage.origin_classification: Frontend: accepted application source. CRT: runtime.c overrides, explicit CRT variants elsewhere in source, and matched LIBC.LIB/SETARGV code. Imports: import thunks. Includes shared text data; categories are disjoint. This describes accepted reconstruction origins, not a complete original linker map.
coverage.metric: Union of accepted original code extents, shared text data, CRT and import thunks, clipped to code-section VirtualSize; not branch coverage.

shared_source_policy: Published stable C/H held through final checks; exact before/after SHA set is in evidence/final-checks/quickc-stable-validation.json. Earlier coherent-candidate checks are retained and not relabelled.
failure_history: Native loop descriptor initially used expression arena2; zero recycled state and pending-buffer divergence caught before final acceptance; original pool3 addresses and corrected fresh continuation retained.
Ordinary missing header/declaration-scope/token-enum build errors retained with successful corrected build logs.
One premature V1 native debug attempted before original capture completion; workspace failure retained, existing original reused.
scope: Standalone C1 frontend -qc/-Ol/-Oe interface; no CL producer or C2 compatibility claim, no target-global seeding. Unknown/support/padding remains unclassified; not CRT-only.
source_revision_policy: Original v1 raw/source/oracles stay pinned; v2 adds actually used short parameters and has fresh exact original baselines before native oracle.
evidence_policy: Ordinary owned files/path+hash bindings; no copied executable/toolchain/auditor/build bundle. Raw logs unchanged.
